sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border E-Commerce Overseas Warehouse Order Fulfillment

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Law heritage, with customary law; a unitary national legal system without sub-state tax distinctions)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 November 2006; in force 2007)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) (signed 2017; in force 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia (2010); Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand (2009)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended; Sections 40, 45 and 92); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014 (as amended); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) AML/CFT Rulebook and Guidance Notes issued under the financial intelligence framework; Financial Transaction Reporting Act [Cap. 37]; Companies Act [Cap. 191] (domestic companies). Beneficial ownership details are collected and held by licensed registered agents and the VFSC pursuant to the AML/CFT Act and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014, aligned with FATF Recommendation 24.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner's passport data page
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Chinese Embassy/Consulate Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association of any direct corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Consular Legalization through the competent Vanuatu or Chinese diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each direct corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or equivalent competent authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Consular Legalization; issued within 90 days before submission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vanuatu licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed company or its beneficial owners (executed before a notary public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Consular Legalization; must accompany the incorporation application

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming UBO identity and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBO's relationship bank or financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letterhead; notarized and consular legalized; countersigned by the Account Officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Due Diligence Questionnaire (source of wealth and source of funds declaration) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed registered agent using VFSC-approved template
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Executed before notary public and legalized by consulate; retained in the agent's CDD file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all directors, shareholders, registered agents and UBOs against the consolidated Vanuatu sanctions list, United Nations Security Council resolutions, OFAC SDN list, UK HM Treasury sanctions, and EU restrictive measures; enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval are required for any Politically Exposed Person (PEP), with a cure period of no more than 30 days to resolve false-positive alerts. Screening must be repeated at the time of incorporation, at each renewal cycle, and upon any change of UBO.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as consolidated), sections 5 and 7 (incorporation procedures), section 18 (registered office), section 24 (directors and secretary), section 27 (tax exemption and offshore status); supported by the VFSC International Companies (Incorporation) Rules 1993 and the Companies (Cross-Border) Regulations where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Level 2, Touring Building, Kumul Highway, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company submitted through a VFSC-Licensed Registered Agent, culminating in the issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique VFSC International Company number.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the International Companies Act; the authorized share capital is declared voluntarily in the Articles of Association and may be expressed in USD. No escrow account, capital deposit, or proof-of-funds undertaking is required at incorporation. The USD 300 statutory fee is the combined VFSC incorporation and name clearance fee; annual VFSC renewal fees are payable separately through the Registered Agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company adopt the office of its Registered Agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu as its registered office and that the Registered Agent file all statutory notices with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED THAT the subscription of shares by the sole subscriber under the Memorandum and Articles of Association be confirmed and recorded in the Register of Members, and share certificates be issued. RESOLVED THAT [Name] of [Address] be and is hereby appointed Director and that [Name] be appointed Secretary, each to serve until removal or resignation. RESOLVED THAT the Director be authorized to open bank accounts and execute all agreements necessary to implement the foregoing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Offshore Licensing Gap Assessment and Cross-Border Operational Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) Business Licence Office, and Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Board documents that the cross-dock 3PL order fulfillment hub will be physically situated outside Vanuatu, consistent with the International Company's prohibition on domestic business under the International Companies Act. For the overseas facility, no Vanuatu industrial or environmental authorizations apply; the company obtains and files with its Registered Agent the relevant foreign warehouse lease, occupational safety certificates, and customs/quarantine approvals of the jurisdiction where the warehouse operates. If any physical facility is ever established within Vanuatu, a domestic Business Licence under the Business Licence Act and an environmental registration under the Environment Act would be required before operations commence.
required_dossiers: Director's statement confirming the offshore location of the fulfillment hub
Copy of the overseas warehouse lease or third-party logistics service agreement
Foreign jurisdiction operating permits, fire safety certificates, and occupancy permits (if applicable)
Annual confirmation of Registered Agent deemed to comply with VFSC beneficial ownership rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Vanuatu Revenue or VFSC determines that the International Company is carrying on domestic physical operations contrary to the Act, the company must immediately convert the Vanuatu presence to a local company, apply for a Business Licence through VIPA, and obtain a retrospective operational waiver while a fresh domestic incorporation is completed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for the International Company status; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), Business Licence Office, for any incidental physical business presence in Vanuatu through a domestic vehicle
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating permit or business licence is required for the offshore overseas-warehouse cross-dock model performed by an International Company. Any physical warehousing placed within Vanuatu would require a Business Licence under the Vanuatu Business Licence Act and an Occupation Certificate from the relevant Municipal Council, but such licensing is outside the current scoped offshore configuration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not applicable to the offshore fulfillment hub. If a Vanuatu-based site of more than 1,000 m² were ever utilized, the facility would fall within Category 2 (Registration under the Environment Impact Assessment Regulations 2011) requiring a registration form and a preliminary environmental screen; facilities exceeding 5,000 m² or involving hazardous goods storage would require a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Cross-dock order fulfillment generates no process wastewater, VOCs, or combustion emissions in the ordinary course. Backup diesel generators, if installed at any Vanuatu location, must meet the Vanuatu atmospheric emission guidelines for particulate matter and NOx, and fuel-storage tanks above 2,000 liters require DEPC fuel storage registration. All waste packaging materials must be handled by a DEPC-approved waste contractor under the Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for the offshore 3PL hub. If a Vanuatu physical site were established, the operator would need (i) a Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service, (ii) a structural load approval from the Public Works Department under the Vanuatu Building Act, (iii) an Occupational Safety Clearance from the Labour Inspectorate confirming compliance with workplace noise, racking, forklift, and manual-handling standards, and (iv) a municipal Occupation Certificate from the local council.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (no standard income-tax administration exists); company and entity registry administration is vested in the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), official portal https://www.vfsc.vu, with customs operational clearance processed through ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Appoint a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, as required under the International Companies Act (Cap 222); non-resident ownership is permitted and no minimum capital is required. Step 2: The agent files the Memorandum and Articles of Association with VFSC; the resulting VFSC Registration Number serves as the entity's statutory identifier in lieu of any TIN. Step 3: Obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing; a Vanuatu resident agent is mandatory. Step 4: No inland-revenue TIN, VAT ID, or tax registration is issued or required because Vanuatu imposes no income tax and has no VAT/GST regime; the International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxation, stamp duty, and exchange-control filing obligations. Step 5: Registration with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue for an importer code is triggered only if the IC physically imports goods into Vanuatu; pure offshore e-commerce warehouse fulfillment under ISIC 5210 does not trigger any domestic tax registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu domestic law provides no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election because the International Company is absolutely tax-exempt under the International Companies Act (Cap 222). For foreign tax purposes, a Vanuatu IC is an eligible entity (it is not on the IRS per-se corporation list), so a U.S. Federal Form 8832 check-the-box election may be filed to classify it as a disregarded entity, partnership, or corporation; single-member default is disregarded status and multi-member default is partnership. Vanuatu has not implemented BEPS Action 2 hybrid-mismatch rules, so the IC may operate as a hybrid financing vehicle in cross-border structures without adverse domestic consequences.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Vanuatu has no VAT, GST, or general sales tax; residual indirect levies are customs import duties under the Customs Act (Cap 61), a turnover tax on specified domestic services, and stamp duty, none of which apply to an exempt International Company engaged in offshore e-commerce fulfillment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST statute exists in Vanuatu and therefore no economic-turnover threshold for indirect-tax registration is fixed in Vanuatu vatu (VUV). A local Business Licence fee applies under the Business Licences Act only to activities carried on within Vanuatu and is inapplicable to an IC with no local fixed place of business.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — Vanuatu imposes no mandatory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, tax-authority API integration, or digital stamping. Import and export movements are declared solely through the ASYCUDA World customs clearance platform; commercial documentation remains paper or PDF based with no fiscal clearance stamp for offshore services.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — because Vanuatu levies no VAT/GST, there is no 0% export VAT rate to claim and no refund mechanism to engage. All exports of goods and offshore services, including third-party logistics order fulfillment for overseas e-commerce (ISIC 5210), fall entirely outside the scope of Vanuatu indirect taxation, and no application, ruling, or prior approval is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World submission) where goods physically transit Vanuatu
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export shipment and destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Certificate of Good Standing issued by VFSC evidencing tax-exempt status and corporate valid existence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No domestic export zero-rating claim exists, so no Vanuatu VAT refund can be clawed back; however, materially false customs declarations attract penalties under the Customs Act (Cap 61), including monetary fines, forfeiture of goods, and imprisonment, and misuse of the International Company's exempt status may lead to VFSC deregistration and disqualification of directors. In foreign jurisdictions that do impose VAT, any fraudulent zero-rating, export-fraud, or input-credit scheme executed through the Vanuatu IC may trigger retrospective assessments, interest, penalties, and joint liability against the IC and its beneficial owners; the 180-day proceeds-repatriation benchmark is applied by third-party banking and tax due diligence as a traceability standard despite the absence of domestic Vanuatu exchange controls.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for all current account transactions when effected through authorized dealers. Capital account transactions remain formally subject to exchange control supervision; however, non-resident International Companies face minimal impediments, as inbound capital injections and outward profit remittances are handled by banks as routine before-approval-exempt transfers when supported by corporate documentation. Profit remittance hurdles relate primarily to anti-money laundering source-of-funds verification rather than FX convertibility restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio is imposed on export proceeds under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 33]. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency or converted at the exporter's discretion; periodic reporting to the RBV through authorized dealers is required for balance-of-payments statistics only.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex) can serve as supplementary treasury rails for multi-currency cross-border payments after a seamless API integration; however, they are not locally authorized to hold VUV balances or clear domestic transactions. Using such EMIs as the primary liquidity vehicle would trigger unlicensed payment-service risk and may be rejected by Vanuatu auditors because of the absence of local AML/CFT supervisory cooperation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally permitted for International Companies, provided that all directors and UBOs submit notarized KYC packs and participate in a mandatory video-conference interview. A physical appearance in Vanuatu may be waived for low-risk corporate structures, but the bank may require an in-person or embassy-verified interview when the corporate owner or signatory resides in a FATF-high-risk jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholder or complex ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incumbency, verified UBO register with the registered agent, an organizational chart evidencing controlling shareholders, and signed declarations from each nominee disclaiming beneficial entitlement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume third-party payments to overseas warehouse vendors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed commercial warehousing and 3PL service agreements, client purchase orders, warehouse receipts, and a cash-flow projection demonstrating trade-backed payment density.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors with no physical Vanuatu presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passports, proof of outward remittance of professional fees, signed director consent and authority letters, plus a registered-agent certificate confirming the IC's good standing under the International Companies Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from a jurisdiction with strict exchange controls
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds pack: six-month bank statements of the funder, corporate registration of the remitter, board resolution authorizing the transfer, and a written explanation of the economic substance of the cross-border 3PL arrangement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire transfers must be routed via SWIFT MT103 through an authorized dealer in Vanuatu, using the purpose code 'Capital Injection' or 'Equity Contribution' for Regulatory Reporting (Economic and Financial Statistics). The beneficiary account must carry the IC legal name and account number, and the bank must hold on file: a board resolution, share subscription documents, and a statement of source of funds. For VUV amounts, an exchange-control declaration (Form EC1) is completed by the bank; no RBV pre-approval is required for non-resident equity injections into an International Company.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border payments for overseas warehouse subcontracting, freight forwarding, and order fulfillment are cleared through SWIFT MT103 direct remittance. Larger contracts may be backed by commercial letters of credit issued in favour of foreign 3PL vendors, with settlement against presentation of warehouse receipt, packing list, and proof of delivery. Local ACH rails are restricted to VUV-denominated domestic payments and cannot be used for cross-border disbursements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (deliverable) with tenors up to 12 months for USD/VUV, AUD/VUV, EUR/VUV, and GBP/VUV, executed with an authorized dealer in Vanuatu.
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD or AUD, subject to RBV collateral rules and prudent mark-to-market provisions.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV executed solely offshore with a licensed OECD counterparty when local deliverable liquidity is insufficient; cleared outside the jurisdiction to avoid domestic exchange-control restrictions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (confirmation of registered agent, registered office, directors, shareholders, and share capital)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary; VFSC annual government fee payable concurrently
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Strict-liability filing offence; escalating late-filing penalties apply from the first month of default, and persistent non-filing results in administrative strike-off by the VFSC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each incorporation anniversary; 30-day grace period allowed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee after the grace period; non-payment for 6 months or more triggers administrative strike-off, asset vesting in the Republic, and reinstatement only upon payment of arrears, penalties, and restoration fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register (lodged by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the annual return on the incorporation anniversary; additionally within 14 days of any shareholding transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 84,000) against the company plus daily accrual penalties for continued default; false or incomplete UBO declarations impose personal fines on directors and officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Retainer Renewal (statutorily mandatory engagement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila (commercial mandate; VFSC-monitored)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in advance on the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent resignation without a replacement within 90 days requires VFSC notification and subject the company to administrative strike-off; the IC cannot maintain legal standing or execute valid transactions without a serving registered agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A standard Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory audit and public account filing under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; compulsory audit applies only to VFSC-licensed banking, insurance, or securities businesses, which are outside the e-commerce cross-dock 3PL scope.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework or tax-basis reporting is prescribed for International Companies under the zero-tax regime; IFRS is the prudent commercial standard for internally prepared management accounts and lender or creditor reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent maintains the Beneficial Ownership Register; every share transfer or UBO movement must be updated and reported to the VFSC within 14 days, with an annual UBO confirmation annexed to the anniversary annual return certifying alignment between the Register of Members and current beneficial owners.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,200 per annum (full corporate secretarial and registered office service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable - no statutory audit for Vanuatu ICs; voluntary independent review USD 2,000 - 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil corporate income tax; Vanuatu does not levy any CIT, branch profits tax, capital gains tax, or payroll tax on income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, inheritance tax, gift tax, and withholding tax under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The only recurring burden is the annual VFSC government fee (approximately VUV 26,250–120,000 / USD 220–1,000 depending on authorized share capital and structure), plus Vanuatu National Provident Fund contributions if local employees are engaged. No tax rulings or incentives are available because the effective rate is already zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return under Section 93 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] (VFSC Form IC-AR), filed electronically through the VFSC Online Registry (e-VFSC portal) by the licensed registered agent
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — due on each anniversary of incorporation, not on a fiscal-year-end basis
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 1 calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; no statutory extension mechanism exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the incorporation certificate character-for-character; no trade names or abbreviated versions accepted
Used as the master key in e-VFSC; include this number in all bank and payment-rail KYC references

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the licensed registered agent's physical address; a PO Box alone is not acceptable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and signature of the VFSC-licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the statutory point of service for all government notices and must be maintained at all times

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and nationality of all directors in office during the reporting year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; the declaration may be signed by the agent under a power of attorney if no director is physically present

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 — Shareholders and register of members
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, classes of shares, and shareholdings expressed in Vatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners must be disclosed to the agent for AML records; nominee structures must name the ultimate beneficial owner on the agent's beneficial ownership register

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 — Authorized and issued share capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Maximum authorized capital and total issued share capital in Vatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; keep authorized capital conservative (e.g., VUV 100,000–1,000,000 equivalent) because the annual government fee increases with capital

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company has complied with the International Companies Act and has not conducted business with Vanuatu residents without holding a local business licence
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration is a criminal offence; the director or agent signing must verify actual activity, including overseas cross-dock fulfilment operations

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a surcharge of 10% of the annual government fee; if the return and fee remain unpaid 60 days after the due date, the Registrar may strike the company off the register without further notice. After strike-off, the company loses legal capacity and Vanuatu-situs assets vest in the Registrar. Restoration requires a court order plus payment of all arrears and penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; distributions are made free of source-state taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network. The only bilateral instruments in force are Tax Information Exchange Agreements (e.g., with Australia and New Zealand), which provide no rate relief. Because there is no income tax, the VFSC does not issue tax residence certificates; banks instead accept (i) the Certificate of Incorporation, (ii) the Certificate of Good Standing, and (iii) a registered agent letter as documentary evidence of tax-exempt status for payment rail and interbank due diligence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate: 0% for royalties, interest, management fees, and fulfilment service fees paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA). Profit repatriation via intercompany settlement flows, cross-dock invoicing, or shareholder advances is entirely untaxed at source; the operative constraints are economic substance compliance and AML obligations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A in VUV — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File obligation, no country-by-country reporting threshold, and no thin-capitalisation rules. Documentation duties arise only indirectly under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, which requires an IC to evidence locally performed core income-generating activities where the cross-dock/overseas fulfilment activity is within the 'distribution and service centre' category.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 obliges every IC to file a substance declaration with VFSC. For ISIC 5210 cross-dock/overseas 3PL fulfilment, the relevant activity is 'distribution and service centre'. The IC must: (i) be managed and controlled in Vanuatu (board meetings and minutes held in-country), (ii) maintain adequate physical premises and full-time employees in Vanuatu, and (iii) perform the core income-generating activity in Vanuatu. Vanuatu suspended enforcement during 2021–2022 but has recommitted to phased enforcement to address FATF grey-listing and OECD/Global Forum scrutiny. A 3PL IC that is a mere contract name-plate without local workforce, office, or bank account will fall within the 'no economic substance' category and must be reported as such; banks increasingly require an economic substance return receipt before opening or maintaining USD settlement accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / sham economic substance under the Economic Substance Act
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the e-commerce fulfilment treasury through the Vanuatu IC while all operational decisions, premises, employees, and core logistics functions are located outside Vanuatu, and failing to file the annual economic substance return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, VFSC may impose a financial penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000 per breach plus VUV 100,000 for each continued month of non-compliance, order deregistration, and exchange intelligence with foreign tax authorities under TIEAs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the false substance declaration are personally liable for the penalty; courts may issue asset freezes and travel bans. Shadow directors at the Hong Kong/China operations hub identified through board minutes, email control, or bank mandates are equally exposed to civil restitution claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent trading and false statutory declaration (International Companies Act)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Signing the annual return declaration falsely stating compliance with the International Companies Act while the IC is actively earning fulfilment fees outside the declared scope, or carrying on business with intent to defraud creditors by shifting assets out of the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 12 months per offence. On winding-up, the court may order persons knowingly party to fraudulent trading to personally discharge all company debts — enforceable directly against the parent entity that dictated the sham.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of any distributions paid when solvency tests were breached; personal liability for unpaid third-party logistics invoices, customs duties, and merchant refunds; disqualification from managing any VFSC-regulated entity and criminal custodial exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-money laundering / unexplained wealth (Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 261])
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Rapid pass-through of cross-border e-commerce settlement funds through the Vanuatu IC without supporting fulfilment documentation, underlying merchant KYC, or legitimate commercial rationale; use of opaque payment rails or high-risk wallets to obscure fund movement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to VUV 1,000,000 per count, proceeds-of-crime confiscation orders, mandatory Suspicious Transaction Report filing by the licensed agent, and freezing of accounts held with clearing banks; referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment for directing the money-flow scheme; disqualification orders; loss of access to the targeted payment rails (ACH, Airwallex, wire) resulting in stranded customer funds and personal exposure to merchant and consumer claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to maintain registered agent / registered office and non-payment of annual fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Allowing the annual VFSC fee to lapse or losing the licensed registered agent while continuing to collect fulfilment fees into the IC bank account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 10% surcharge on unpaid government fees; automatic strike-off after 60 days without notice; on strike-off the company ceases to exist and all Vanuatu-situs assets, including bank balances held through VFSC-licensed banks, vest in the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Loss of limited-liability protection for debts incurred after the strike-off date; directors become personally liable for all e-commerce fulfilment contracts and payment obligations transacted in the company's name thereafter.
